subject: High School Safety Procedures DEI Review
overview: The Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Subcommittee met to review Medford High School's safety and monitoring procedures from an equity perspective. The administration agreed to gather feedback from teachers and analyze student survey data over the summer to report back to the full School Committee in October.

items.title: Review of Medford High School safety procedures from a DEI perspective
items.summary: Committee members and administration discussed the impacts of high school hallway monitoring, bathroom restrictions, and e-hall passes on students, agreeing that the superintendent will compile staff feedback and survey data to present to the full School Committee on October 2.
